name: waiaas
description: Self-hosted wallet MCP server for AI agents. Provides 42 tools for multi-chain crypto operations: transfers, token management, DeFi (swap, lend, stake, bridge, perp), NFT, smart contracts, and x402 payments. Supports EVM and Solana with policy engine, spending limits, and human approval.
